notes.title: Spring Update: Winning Streak!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/0543b0112defc3e1683d3f763368ac655c846beb.png
Heya Warriors!

Challenge yourself and test your fighting skills - how many random levels can you beat in a row? Find out in the all new game mode Winning Streak.

How does Winning Streak work?

Start in Streak level 1
Beat one random level
Level up to Streak level 2
Beat two random levels in a row
Level up to Streak level 3
Beat three random levels in a row
Lost a game? Keep your Streak level and try again!
How far can you make it?

Like New Game Advanced, Winning Streak game mode is accessible after playing through the campaign.


Upcoming achievements

Winning Streak game mode comes with new achievements, wich unlock at 90 reviews! :)
So, Please write a review, claim your Winning Streak achievements and help to unlock more future updates.
Happy smashing! :)

Update: I just added 7 new Achievements :)

Best.
Alex

notes.title: New Game Advanced Update!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/14583508036e397ddf931bc834641640c7e2dd4f.png
Greetings Warriors!

You asked for it in the discussions and now it is there: Prove that you are the dwarf you claim to be and beat the game in New Game Advanced. 

New Game Advanced in detail

Restart the game in a higher difficulty
Increase your maximum attribute points from 40 to 80
Keep your character level and stats
Recollect gold, weapons and sets
Earn prestige
Beat it in tier 1? Try to beat it in tier 2!
Start over


Please write a review - this helps me to keep the game alive! :)
Thanks and have fun! :)

Best,
Alex

notes.title: Update 1.2. It gets fishy
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/d51aadf288e92d142461948665e4ea9e5c80b56c.jpg

Heya dwarven warriors! Here comes Update 1.2 with requested features, improved graphics and a fish you can slap your foes with :)

New Features

- Steam Cloud save added
- Settings for Screen shake added
- Ambient Occlusion for better looking environemts
- Fish-Weapon :)

The update includes also minor fixes and a new balancing too. See details as usual in the discussions thread: Latest Updates


Review Challenge

The next goal (35 Reviews) is about to be reached. Your reward will be a shiny new axe forged with best dwarven intentions ;)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/04fb80a9c4034057c53c004285d4e46375f6c2ec.jpg

If you like what I am doing please write a review!

Best,
Alex

notes.title: Big Loca Update 1.1
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/d82543fe392e7522dcf7a7f76fd56b1db7bc6953.png

Update 1.1 is here, adding 4 new localizations as well as minor fixes and improvements to the game.

You can now play Runic Rampage also in: Italian, Polish, Turkish and Simplified Chinese.. that makes a total of 10 supported languages. That's quite a lot for a grumpy dwarf, isn't it?! :)

Find a list of all changes in the discussions thread: Latest Updates

Best,
Alex
